name: CrossVal-100
description: CrossVal-100 is a 100-item, two-arm benchmark (50 machine-generated research ideas and 50 ideas reconstructed from venue-published papers, each a 7-field tuple), released with its evaluation harness, the 300 ratings of the pre-specified three-judge panel, a judge-robustness bundle of 1,200 further ratings, per-item provenance, a serialization manifest, a release-consistency checker and a payload-identity check. It accompanies the paper "CrossVal-100: Auditing Integrity Invariants in LLM-Judged Research-Ideation Comparisons" (M. Alobed, under review), which uses it to demonstrate three machine-checked integrity invariants for LLM-judged comparisons: generator–judge disjointness, gate liveness and cross-arm format parity. The release is an audit demonstration, not a validated system-ranking benchmark.
